Index is one queryable map of the trees you add: every project, directory,
file, symbol and doc section gets a stable id (alpha:src/lib.rs,
alpha:src/lib.rs#parse, alpha:docs/X.md#a-heading), its place in the tree,
edges to other entities (depends-on, documented-by, tests, co-changes),
and a short summary. Ask it before grep and find: search ranks entities
and gives their paths, show . says where you are and what is here, and
tree PROJECT --depth 1 prints a project's map.

Opt-in: agent index root add DIR adds a tree, and every directory directly
under it becomes a project, a repo or not; agent index crawl reads them.
A crawl is cheap and incremental: it re-reads only files whose git blob
(or, outside git, content hash) changed, and carries renamed files'
summaries and labels over, keeping the old id as an alias. It never
indexes .env*, *.pem, *.key, id_* or *.p12 files, reads no file over 1 MB
or binary file (an entity, no content), and never follows a symlink out
of its project.

Summaries in this version are seeds: what the code itself says (a crate's
description and //! doc, a Go package comment, a docstring, a doc's first
paragraph, a README's first paragraph for its directory, doc comments).
Freshness reads seed (only a seed exists), fresh, stale or none.

The index lives in index.db beside this binary's gomuxai.db; everything
but labels a person or a glossary added is rebuilt by crawl --rebuild.

Usage:
  agent index [flags]
  agent index [command]

Examples:
  agent index root add ~/dev
  agent index crawl
  agent index search "word wall"
  agent index show .
  agent index tree alpha --depth 1

Available Commands:
  root        Add, remove and list the trees the index covers
  project     Make a deeper directory a project, or change a project's depth
  crawl       Bring the index up to date with the files on disk
  search      Search the index: ranked entities with their paths and summaries
  show        Show one entity: where it sits, its summary, children, edges and symbols
  tree        Print a map of a project or directory, with one-line summaries
  related     List an entity's neighbors by edge: dependencies, docs, tests, co-changes
  stale       List what needs a summary, by importance, and doc references that resolve nowhere
  alias       Add a person's label to an entity
  lexicon     Import an existing glossary as labels

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for index

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent index [command] --help" for more information about a command.
